unit.command: node --test tests/enrage-tuning.test.js tests/expedition-v15.test.js tests/native-tactics.test.js tests/arena.test.js tests/expedition-v12.test.js tests/game.test.js tests/overhaul.test.js tests/native-expedition.test.js tests/native-lineage.test.js

checks: Upper-right Settings exposes 13 live sliders, grouped size preview changes, physics resize together, preferences survive reload, tuning pauses and resumes combat, reset restores defaults
Visible equipment pack below companions supports real drag to a creature, transfer between creatures and return to pack without duplication
Failed planned capture can be retried with highlighted Runic/Astral tools via overhead and physical opponent clicks; exactly three attempts spend stock and remain capped after reload
Live countdown enters enrage at 30s, shows exact healing tier/multiplier and next decay, and stops with pause
A real simulated battle produces graph tabs, team comparison, accurate kill timeline, illustrated loot reveal, one-time collection and a persistent recap after reload
Settings, range inputs, recap charts and loot fit 320px and 390px screens
The exact rebuilt single-file game supports settings and battle recap with only its initial HTML request and zero external asset requests
Two-point starter budget rejects Legendary picks and supports one two-point companion in two available places
Quick method/HP selection persists; one tool is reserved; live and reward success notices appear; post-match capture is absent; exactly two rewards
Lethal damage genuinely prevents capture and produces an explicit failure message
Real gear/gem drag/drop preserves ownership; skill ordering persists; tabbed loadouts, ailment hover help and outside dismissal work
Enemy-side relic summary and full equipment are inspectable; shops present exactly two costly relics
Eligible companions have a visible shining evolution notification
UI V2 fits 320/390/768px, uses reachable bottom navigation and tabbed bottom sheets, and dismisses by tapping outside
Choosing the occasional equipment reward grants one character-wide item, persists across reload, and cannot be claimed twice
Mobile star chart and menagerie fit the viewport and remain accessible through bottom navigation

limitations: No fifty-hour human playtest or measured 9/10 fun rating.
Full Chaos campaign difficulty was not re-certified; V15 Chaos-1 policy failure remains historical evidence.
